body: RF-DEC-08, CLI-DEC-07, WF-DEC-07 and RC-DEC-06 retain the reasons for archival preservation, bounded header classification, independent interface versions and fresh supported assessment. The five model amendments and linked owner relationships are the complete changed Design package; examples and runtime resources are mapped for coordinated implementation, not edited here. This is a Design decision, not the required final owner disposition of each old store. Remaining work before removal: assess relevant old review/Verify limitations and governance consumers, refresh work/recovery inventory, allocate exact retained checks in Delivery, and obtain required independent assessment. No project-map reliance: direct owner, code and test inspection supplies the bounded basis.

decisions.rationale: Apply the approved retirement direction through existing owners: RF-SR-14, CLI-SR-28, WF-SR-18, RC-SR-21 and SYS-SR-02/04/06/08/09. Retire the stored contract only after explicit operational-dependency disposition and reviewed coherent implementation/Verify. Preserve independent transport versions, historical provenance and v3 safety; remove v2-only tests without adding retirement/rejection/archive-compatibility tests.
